scientific_integrity: All-n proof provided, with independent direct finite brute-force corroboration for n=3,4,5. Counting uses classical Cayley formula. No certification or independence beyond the explicitly stated review status.
scientific_limitations: Valid for one-edge full subdivisions of labeled complete graphs with n >= 3 and ordinary zero forcing. The scalar zero forcing number was already known for Hamiltonian-base subdivisions; priority of the new entire enumeration cannot be guaranteed against unindexed equivalent incidence-graph or forest enumeration.
title: Minimal forts and the complete zero forcing polynomial of fully subdivided complete graphs
